statements.text: The feedforward sweep is the first wave of activity that a stimulus sends from lower to higher areas through feedforward connections, reaching visual, frontal and motor cortex within roughly the first 100 ms. During it, localized features and categories of the scene are extracted.

sources.quote: The first 100 msecs of visual processing is dominated by feedforward activation of the brain.
everything there is to "know" in terms of localized features and categories about the visual scene is extracted
